calls.title: Jeff / Christian / Logan
calls.summary: The meeting covered the current status of an integration project facing delays mainly due to prolonged security reviews impacting procurement. Jeff Do detailed issues with the Statsig-to-GrowthBook migration tool, which crashes with large datasets, and requested enhancements in SQL editing and in-app guidance for better user experience. Shi Hao aims to complete SDK development by June 30, while Logan offered additional support to mitigate risks. It was also noted that a planned visit to the Bay Area later in June aims to strengthen partnerships and address feature requests. Overall, effective communication and coordination across multiple teams were emphasized as critical for moving forward with the integration.
calls.keywords: SDK Implementation, Security Review, Warehouse Native Connection, Migration Tool, SQL Editing, MCP Server Integration
